topic: Adjusting metrics based on face count changes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on which campaign metrics change when the number of faces per frame is adjusted. It was confirmed that `Viewed_impressions_per_face` and `Viewable_impressions_per_face` should change, while `Viewed_impressions`, `total_traffic`, `Reach`, and `Visits_frequency` should remain constant.

Confusion arose regarding the UI display of these metrics. It was noted that `Viewed_impressions` is not displayed on the 'Audience Selected' panel; instead, `Viewed_impressions_per_face` and `Viewable_impressions_per_face` are shown there.

Finally, a potential issue affecting the frequency metric in Brazil was identified and addressed, which was attributed to an incorrect calculation of the number of frames.
decisions: The metrics `Viewed_impressions_per_face` and `Viewable_impressions_per_face` are expected to change when adjusting faces per frame.
`Viewed_impressions`, `total_traffic`, `Reach`, and `Visits_frequency` should not change regardless of face count adjustments.
action_items: [p2] will test the findings regarding metric changes.
